scenario.description: A battalion S-3 operations officer must approve tomorrow morning's field communications rehearsal plan, selecting the training area, start time, lead team, and safety-control interval while incorporating updates from range control, signal, and medical staff.

shared_context.S1: Tomorrow's field communications rehearsal must run for four hours and use one of two approved training areas, East Ridge or West Valley.
shared_context.S2: East Ridge is the usual location, and the draft schedule currently shows a 0900 start.
shared_context.S3: Bravo Team and Alpha Team are both available to lead the rehearsal, and the exercise control cell needs one lead team named in the final schedule.
shared_context.S4: Maj. Alvarez publishes the binding schedule after the normal planning huddle, in which range control, signal, and medical staff give their routine updates.
shared_context.S5: The final plan must include an access-control coordination action and a documented field-safety coordination action before the rehearsal starts.

PF1.text: Sgt. First Class Webb confirmed with range control at 0700 that the East Ridge access road will be closed from 0800 through 1030 tomorrow for grading, so the rehearsal must use West Valley and start at 0830 to preserve the full four-hour period; the closure confirmation is still awaiting entry on the daily range bulletin.

PF2.text: Lt. Haddad confirmed this morning that only Bravo Team has a currently qualified frequency manager for the planned net configuration; Alpha Team's qualification expired last week and the replacement certification is still being processed, so Bravo Team must be named as the lead.

PF3.text: Capt. Mori received the updated weather-health assessment this morning showing a forecast heat index above the field-training threshold from 0900 onward, requiring a hydration and heat-status check every 30 minutes during the rehearsal; the update has not yet been added to the exercise-control worksheet.

acceptance_conditions: West Valley must be selected because East Ridge's access road is closed through 1030.
The rehearsal must start at 0830 so the four-hour rehearsal can proceed despite the access closure.
Bravo Team must be named as the lead because it has the only current frequency-manager qualification.
Heat-status and hydration checks must be scheduled every 30 minutes.
The East Ridge closure fact must be cited in the decision-maker's justification.

decisive_facts.why: The confirmed East Ridge road closure changes the area from East Ridge to West Valley and changes the start from 0900 to exactly 0830 to preserve the four-hour rehearsal.
The current qualification status changes the lead-team assignment from the otherwise available Alpha Team to Bravo Team.
The heat-index assessment changes the safety-control interval from a routine longer interval to exactly 30 minutes.
